# Import Activity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](gmeow-ImportActivity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ImportActivity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/provenance`](../../slices/provenance.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An activity that ingested an external source artifact (an import envelope such as a vCard file) and recorded the claims it carried. Carries the ingestion (transaction) time — when the system learned the claims, distinct from when they were asserted or when they hold.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](gmeow-ImportActivity.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when modeling the ingestion of an external source — a vCard, mbox, or feed pulled in — so the transaction time and the source mapping become first-class and auditable.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for in-system derivations that produce no external-source envelope (use a plain [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md) with [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md)) and for the moment a fact was asserted by an observer (that is statement-level [`gmeow:assertedAt`](../properties/gmeow-assertedAt.md), not ingestion).

### How to use

- Type the import as [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](gmeow-ImportActivity.md), stamp it with [`gmeow:ingestedAt`](../properties/gmeow-ingestedAt.md), tie it to its software agent with [`gmeow:wasAssociatedWith`](../properties/gmeow-wasAssociatedWith.md), and record per-claim [`gmeow:mappedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-mappedFrom.md) / [`gmeow:importanceLevel`](../properties/gmeow-importanceLevel.md) on the statements it generated; the ingested claims point back via [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md).

### Examples

- ex:import2026 a [`gmeow:ImportActivity`](gmeow-ImportActivity.md); [`gmeow:ingestedAt`](../properties/gmeow-ingestedAt.md) "2026-06-15T09:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
